description: Local Linux OS operations: file reading/writing/deletion, shell execution, process monitoring, and git version control.
routing_rules: Assign when inspecting local files, directory trees, terminal scripts, or git repositories.

tools.name: sys_exec
tools.description: Executes a Linux bash or shell command with a timeout deadline, or launches background/GUI processes detached.

tools.name: sys_ps
tools.description: Lists active operating system processes, memory usage, CPU, and PIDs.

tools.name: sys_kill
tools.description: Terminates an operating system process by process ID (PID) using POSIX signals.

tools.name: sys_exec_python
tools.description: Executes Python code in an isolated subprocess with a timeout.

tools.name: sys_volume_get
tools.description: Gets current master audio volume percentage and mute status via pactl or amixer.

tools.name: sys_volume_set
tools.description: Sets master audio volume percentage.

tools.name: sys_volume_mute
tools.description: Toggles or sets master audio mute state.

tools.name: sys_brightness_get
tools.description: Gets current display brightness percentage.

tools.name: sys_brightness_set
tools.description: Sets display brightness percentage.

tools.name: sys_lock
tools.description: Locks the Linux desktop session immediately.

tools.name: sys_suspend
tools.description: Suspends the system into sleep mode.

tools.name: sys_health
tools.description: Collects full Linux system health diagnostics.

tools.name: sys_clipboard_copy
tools.description: Copies text to Linux clipboard using xclip or wl-copy.

tools.name: sys_clipboard_paste
tools.description: Pastes text from Linux clipboard using xclip or wl-paste.

tools.name: sys_launch_app
tools.description: Launches a desktop GUI application detached in background.

tools.name: sys_get_time
tools.description: Gets exact local and UTC time, date, weekday, and timezone.

tools.name: fs_read
tools.description: Reads file content with optional line slicing and offset limits.

tools.name: fs_write
tools.description: Atomically creates or overwrites a file, or appends content to an existing file.

tools.name: fs_delete
tools.description: Permanently deletes a file or directory tree from the filesystem.

tools.name: fs_list
tools.description: Lists contents of a directory with file sizes, types, and modified timestamps.

tools.name: fs_ripgrep
tools.description: Fast regex search across files and directories via ripgrep.

tools.name: git_status
tools.description: Retrieves git repository status, active branch, and modified files.

tools.name: git_diff
tools.description: Inspects git diff against HEAD, working tree, or specific commits.

tools.name: git_commit
tools.description: Stages all changes or specific files and creates a git commit with a message.
